_about: What the goal keeps for every version after the first: what changed and what it did to the scores.

versions.why: Scoring changed: new signal: Boil water notices in the last twelve months; red flag on Boil water notices in the last twelve months; thresholds of Days sales outstanding
changes: New signal **Boil water notices in the last twelve months** in Water Quality and Contaminants. Rule: 1 = none in twelve months; 2 = one in twelve months; 3 = two or three in twelve months; 4 = more than three in twelve months (my proposal; change it on the Plan tab). It is a **red flag**: at its worst case the project rates at least 3.
**Days sales outstanding**: 1 = under 45 days; 2 = 45 to 60 days; 3 = 60 to 75 days; 4 = 75 days or more. The thresholds were 45, 60, 90 (days).
